title: Parse Simulation Test Results
description: Turn a simple simulation transcript into a test summary.
task: Implement parse_test_results(lines). Each line may start with PASS:, FAIL:, or SKIP:. Return a dictionary with integer counts under the keys passed, failed, and skipped. Ignore blank lines and unrecognized lines.
constraints: Do not count lines without one of the three recognized prefixes.
The result must always contain all three keys.

testCases.name: ignore blank and unknown lines
testCases.code: assert parse_test_results(['', 'INFO: starting', 'PASS: a', ' PASS: b']) == {'passed': 1, 'failed': 0, 'skipped': 0}

title: Find the First Scoreboard Mismatch
description: Find the first index where a reference model and DUT output disagree.
task: Implement first_mismatch(expected, actual). Return the first index where the values differ. If all shared positions match but the lists have different lengths, return the length of the shorter list. Return None if the lists are identical.
constraints: Do not modify either input list.
Treat a length difference as a mismatch.

title: Count Signal Transitions
description: Count rising and falling transitions in a sampled digital signal.
task: Implement count_transitions(samples). Count each adjacent pair whose values differ. For example, [0, 0, 1, 1, 0] contains two transitions. Return 0 for fewer than two samples.

title: Find Missing Coverage Bins
description: Compare observed coverage bins with the bins required by a test plan.
task: Implement missing_bins(required, observed). Return the required bin names that are absent from observed, preserving the order in required. Each bin name is a string.
constraints: Preserve the order of required bins.
Do not return duplicates from required.

title: Summarize Transaction Latency
description: Compute simple latency statistics from transaction measurements.
task: Implement summarize_latency(samples). Return a dictionary with min, max, and average. The average must be a float. For an empty list, return None for all three values.
constraints: Do not modify the input list.
